Dear Merchery Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Creative Content Associate position at Merchery, as advertised. Your vision for beautiful, useful, and thoughtfully sourced corporate gifts deeply resonates with my approach to content creation.

My background in digital marketing, coupled with hands-on experience in content writing, website management, and social media integration, aligns well with the responsibilities outlined. I am particularly drawn to the opportunity to contribute to Merchery's visual and editorial world.

My CV is attached, detailing my technical skills and experience in bringing content to life online. I have also included a link to my portfolio, as requested, to give you a sense of my creative thinking and the type of work I enjoy making.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Merchery.

cover_letter:
Dear Merchery Team,

I am writing to convey my genuine enthusiasm for the Creative Content Associate role at Merchery. Your commitment to elevating corporate gifting with beautiful, useful, and carefully sourced products is an inspiring vision, and one that I am eager to help amplify through compelling content.

My experience, particularly as a Junior Digital Marketer and Web & SEO Specialist, has equipped me with a robust understanding of content creation and digital presence management. I have actively managed website content for clients using WordPress, Elementor, and Astra, overseeing everything from SEO blog and article writing to consistent layout design and social media integration. This hands-on background in publishing and updating diverse content, along with my HubSpot Content Marketing Certification, has honed my editorial eye and ability to craft engaging, human-centric copy that resonates with audiences — a core requirement Merchery values.

While my CV highlights a technical foundation in SEO and web development, this underpins a 'doer' mentality that thrives on bringing ideas to fruition. I've designed and built websites from structure to content, and maintained complex platforms, demonstrating a practical approach to turning concepts into tangible online experiences. My proficiency in English, coupled with tools like Canva, further supports my capacity to contribute immediately to your visual and editorial needs, developing formats that make Merchery feel recognisable and interesting.

I understand the importance of creative sensitivity and a discerning eye in this role. My work in designing website layouts and optimizing user experience has cultivated an appreciation for visual coherence and impact. I have provided a link to my portfolio, which I believe offers a glimpse into my creative thought process and showcases examples of how I approach content visually and editorially. I am confident that my blend of practical content management, technical understanding, and a keen interest in design and brand building aligns perfectly with Merchery's innovative spirit.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I am excited about the prospect of contributing to your growing brand and would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application further.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Content & CMS Expertise: Proficient in SEO blog & content writing, website content management (WordPress, Elementor, Astra), and using Canva for design, complemented by a HubSpot Content Marketing Certification.
• Website Design & Social Integration: Experience in designing and building websites from structure to content, including social media integration, ensuring a consistent and engaging online presence.
• Hands-on "Doer" Approach: Demonstrated ability to independently build, optimize, and maintain complex web platforms and publish diverse content, reflecting a practical, problem-solving mindset.
• Editorial Eye & Fluent English: Fluent in English with a proven capacity for crafting clear, human-centric copy, developed through practical content creation and certified by HubSpot.
• Organised Project Management: Reliable and comfortable managing several projects independently, from initial ideas to live publication, ensuring ideas make it out effectively.
